_source: Mined from the ZenMode app repo (github.com/ThammanaSrinivas/zenmode), origin/feature/v3 + origin/main, 2026-03-20 → 2026-10-10. Releases are cut at versionCode bumps in app/build.gradle.kts. Newest first. `todos` and `version`/`commits` are review-only and not shown as copy.

releases.title: Zen Check-In, promise streaks, share cards, and your week as a report
releases.intro: This one is about showing up. Small check-ins through the day, a streak built on promises you keep, and cards that celebrate where you've got to. All of it on a Home that's lighter on your battery.

heroMedia.alt: Streak share cards from a 3-day spark to a 400-day orbit

features.title: Zen Check-In
features.body: A gentle check-in now appears through the day and shows how your last hour went. It has its own section in Settings.

features.title: Promise streaks
features.body: Your streak now counts the days you kept your promise. A week strip shows how this week is going, and kept days earn streak coins.

media.alt: The streak share sheet at 30 days kept, beside Zen Gold's week strip one day from unlock

callouts.text: 1 day more under 4 hrs opens gold pay

features.title: Share cards for every milestone
features.body: Every share point now draws a card for what you've actually reached. Streaks grow from a spark to a full orbit, your Zen Score becomes water from still to storm, and your week becomes an animated story.

media.alt: Zen Score share cards, from still water at 9.5 to a stormy 2.5

features.title: Your week, as a report
features.body: Your weekly report now exports as a PDF with the full ZenMode OS wordmark. Everyone can replay their two most recent weeks from Settings. Pro keeps every week and the PDF.

media.alt: Your weekly share studio beside the free weekly reports in Settings

callouts.text: Your last two weeks are free to replay

improvements: What's new on Home: after an update, a short note shows what changed, just once.
A Home that rests: the backdrop and streak flame settle after ten seconds, so an idle Home draws nothing.
Apps open without waiting: today's stats now load in the background.
Gold Holdings: a new screen that shows the gold you've bought.
Random Connect on Zen Circle puts you straight into a circle. No accept step.
Search across every setting: type a few words in any order.
Report a bug sends you to the community Telegram group, where you can attach screenshots and follow the thread.
Screen time matches everywhere: Home, the session log and your circle now agree.
A kinder Zen Score and a more readable session log.
The resistance ring now counts down, 7 to 1.
Apps open in their own task, so they show up in Recents. The Lens button opens Google Lens.
New launcher icons.
fixes: Fixed some apps, such as LinkedIn, not opening from Home.
Kite hand-off now counts as your gold purchase in your Zen Gold balance.
Less background work while your phone is idle: notification counts, the app list and circle refreshes all do less.
Animations stay still when Remove animations is on.
ZenMode OS no longer asks for photo and video access. File search is off in the Play build.
Fixed an issue with sending bug reports.
releases.signoff: Every kept day counts. We're counting with you.

releases.title: Real promise tracking, a first-run guide, and softer sharing
releases.intro: Four quick updates in the week after launch, gathered here. Zen Gold now tracks the promises you actually keep, and Home shows you around the first time.

heroMedia.alt: Zen Gold with gold pay unlocked after five kept days, beside a week where the promise broke and a week one day from unlock

features.title: Promises that track for real
features.body: Zen Gold's screen-time card follows your actual days. Keep your promise five days out of seven and your gold unlocks for the rest of the week. Pro adds a monthly view.

features.title: A guide on your first Home
features.body: After onboarding, a short guide shows you where everything lives: swipe one way for your Zen Score, the other for Zen Gold, and where to find your buddy.

features.title: Softer sharing
features.body: Share sheets now blur the screen behind them instead of blacking it out. Shared cards carry a friendlier caption and a link so friends can find ZenMode OS.

media.alt: Share sheets that blur the page behind: a Zen Circle card and its share preview

improvements: Page dots are tappable: jump straight between Zen Score, Home and Zen Gold.
Zen Gold's forecast follows the real calendar, and the change shows 0% when you have no gold yet.
Streak captions match their length: days and months, not "one month" for everything.
A real eye-off icon for hiding your gold amount.
View T&C opens the terms, and only the link itself is tappable.
The Pro plan page links to a guide for redeeming promo codes.
Onboarding always shows in light mode.
fixes: ZenMode OS stopped asking to turn accessibility back on while it was still running.
Today only counts as kept once it's over, so gold no longer unlocks at noon and locks again by evening.
Fixed text wrapping on the sign-in step.
The search bar follows the keyboard correctly on more phones.
Fixed the theme not resetting properly.
releases.signoff: Settle in. We'll keep smoothing the path.
todos: These are four Play builds (3.02 to 3.05, Sept 21–25). 3.02 and 3.03 were analytics-only, so they're folded in here.

releases.title: Meet ZenMode OS: a new Home, Distraction Blocker, Zen Circle, and Zen Gold
releases.intro: ZenMode is now ZenMode OS. Everything is rebuilt around one idea: reward, not shame. Your home screen is on your side, your friends keep you honest, and keeping your promise earns something real.

heroMedia.alt: ZenMode OS v3 trailer: less screen time turns gold

features.title: A Home that reads your day
features.body: Home sits between two pages: swipe one way for your Zen Score, the other for Zen Gold. The background takes on a calm green, yellow or warm wash depending on how today's screen time is going. New type, new colours and a new mark run through every screen.

features.title: Distraction Blocker
features.body: Turn off YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and Snapchat Spotlight inside the apps themselves. The rest of each app keeps working. It replaces the old 15-minute doomscroll nudge with something quieter that works straight away.

media.alt: Distraction Blocker in Settings: quiet reels and shorts, app by app

features.title: Zen Circle and Zen Bro
features.body: Share your screen time with a friend or a small circle, and send a reaction when someone's having a good day. Invite links open straight into the app, or let Random Connect pair you with someone new.

features.title: Zen Gold and My Promise
features.body: Set a weekly screen-time promise. Keep it and your gold unlocks, ready to invest in real gold through Kite.

media.alt: Scroll less. Stack gold. ZenMode OS Home with gold coins

improvements: Search everything from one bar on Home, with the ZenMode OS gradient tracing its edge as you type.
Zen Score screen: a daily number with your app categories and a session log behind it.
Streaks now follow your Zen Score, with a milestone card to save or share.
Redesigned Settings, with your plan and a screen-time chart up top.
A new onboarding that walks you through setting a promise and finding your circle.
A weekly recap of how your week went.
Zen Pro: more Random Connects, more promise edits, monthly tracking, themes and data export.
Soft interface sounds and matching haptics, with an off switch in Settings.
A new app icon: the ZenMode mark.
One less permission at setup. Display over other apps is no longer needed.
Better contrast for muted text in light mode.
fixes: Phone and Contacts no longer hide each other on MIUI and similar phones.
Screen time no longer counts time spent on the home screen itself.
The accessibility service is sturdier, so the permission stops switching itself off.
Dark mode no longer inverts text on the stats cards.
The resistance screen is off by default; turn it on in Settings if you want it.
Retired: the doomscroll monitor, the distracting-apps picker and app pinning.
releases.signoff: Quiet the noise, together. Welcome to ZenMode OS.
todos: 3.01 went out the same day (Sept 21) and is folded in here.

releases.title: Reactions, notification dots, and pinned apps
releases.intro: Accountability got a little warmer. Cheer your buddy on with a tap, and see what's waiting for you without opening every app.

features.title: Send your buddy a reaction
features.body: Had a good day together? Send a like straight from Home. Your buddy gets a notification, and you'll see theirs come back.

features.title: Notification dots on Home
features.body: Apps on Home show how many notifications they're holding, so you can check at a glance without opening each app.

features.title: Pin apps and jump to app info
features.body: Keep the apps you use on purpose pinned to Home, and reach any app's info page in a tap.

improvements: Change which apps count as distracting from a simple sheet in Settings.
Skip Google sign-in during setup if you'd rather not.
Cleaner spacing throughout.
fixes: Fixed an onboarding background and a memory leak.
releases.signoff: A small nudge from a friend goes a long way.

releases.title: Zen Buddy, Random Connect, and streaks you can share
releases.intro: The first version of ZenMode's big idea: you don't have to do this alone. Share your screen time with someone you trust and keep each other honest.

features.title: Zen Buddy
features.body: Pair up with a friend and see each other's screen time for the day. That's accountability, without the guilt.

features.title: Random Connect
features.body: No one to pair with yet? Random Connect matches you with another ZenMode user who's working on the same thing.

features.title: Streaks, and sharing them
features.body: A new streaks card on Home tracks your mindful days in a row. Share it when you're proud of it.

improvements: Sign in with email, not just Google.
A clearer setup screen explains why ZenMode needs accessibility access.
Dark mode now carries through onboarding too.
Update prompts are gentler: you can choose to update tomorrow.
fixes: Fixed fonts not loading on some phones.
Removed the unlock counter from your stats.

releases.title: A pause that reads the room, a new Home, and dark mode
releases.intro: Version 2 rebuilds the basics. A fresh onboarding and Home, a pause before distracting apps that changes with your day, and a theme for every hour.

features.title: A resistance screen with a mood
features.body: Before a distracting app opens, ZenMode takes a seven-second breath with you. The screen looks calm, neutral or uneasy depending on how your day is going.

features.title: A rebuilt onboarding and Home
features.body: Setup walks you through each step, and Home has a clearer layout with your stats on hand.

features.title: Light and dark
features.body: ZenMode now comes in light and dark, so it fits any time of day.

improvements: A redesigned doomscroll check-in with a clear Close app button.
releases.signoff: Breathe in. Breathe out. Then decide.

releases.title: ZenMode is here: a quieter home screen, open source from day one
releases.intro: The first release of ZenMode. It's a minimalist launcher that puts a little space between you and the scroll, and it's open source all the way down.

heroMedia.alt: Zenmode, an aesthetic and mindful launcher. An OSS product, FOSS United.

features.title: A minimalist launcher
features.body: ZenMode replaces your home screen with a simple list of the apps you mean to use, and today's screen time sits right on top.

features.title: A pause before you open
features.body: Opening a distracting app starts a short countdown first. Seven seconds is often enough to remember why you picked up your phone.

features.title: A nudge when the scroll runs long
features.body: If you've been scrolling for more than 15 minutes, ZenMode checks in and asks whether you still mean to be there.

improvements: Open source under GPLv3 from the very first commit. Anyone can build it, no keys required.
releases.signoff: Day one. Thanks for being here.
